name: The Warden
barks_idle: Ah. Another one. I was beginning to think the stairs had forgotten how to bring me company.
Do not bother with your name. The depths file you under 'visitor' regardless.
I have been the Warden of this floor since before the upper city had walls. The math is unflattering.
Once, I was sent down here to keep something locked away. The thing is gone. The post remains.
Every adventurer asks the same first question: 'what guards the bottom?' The honest answer is 'habit'.
You carry less than the last one. They had a lute. I think of that lute often.
If you turn around now, I will pretend I did not see you. That offer expires when you step closer.
Very well. Lift whatever you brought. I have not been properly tested in three centuries.
*chains rattle into a shape that suggests, regrettably, a stance*
barks_combat: *the chains move on their own; they have done this before*
I take no pleasure in this. I take nothing in this. That is the trouble.
